concerns.text: Task T001’s verification step runs the full pipeline (`python -m code.pipeline.run_all …`) and expects a successful end‑to‑end run. This end‑to‑end run depends on artifacts produced by later tasks (e.g., scoring functions from T002, simulated data from T003, compliance processing from T004, etc.). Placing T001 before those producer tasks creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the directory tree, writes configuration files, and executes the full pipeline which writes many of the same files later produced by other tasks. Running T001 in parallel with any other task could cause race conditions or file‑overwrite conflicts, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
